error[ZBX-E0206]: invalid container name
  while  reading the container name
  cause  'Web_1' has a character at position 1 that is not a lowercase letter, a
         digit or '-'
  name   Web_1
  fix    a valid name looks like this:   zbx run --name web-1 --rootfs ./alpine -- /bin/sh
  more   zbx explain E0206
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0206.html
